note: Versioned truth contracts for the #1040 A5 benchmark dimensions (secrets, IaC/misconfiguration, DAST, CSPM, runtime host-CVE). Each records its own positive/unit semantics, corpus provenance, committed recall/precision floors, and its Unknown/NotAssessed posture. Per the EPIC's no-false-suppression guardrail, no dimension converts an unknown or unassessable input into a clean/compliant result. SAST (per-CWE) and reachability carry their own contracts in the #1039 and reachability lanes.

secrets.positive: a planted non-live credential in a provider-recognized format
secrets.unknown_semantics: Closed corpus: planted secrets plus false-positive traps, no NotAssessed state. A high-entropy value without a provider format is a trap the scanner must NOT flag, not an Unknown; abstaining on it is correct, flagging it is a precision miss.
secrets.provenance: internal/infrastructure/tools/secretscan/gitleaks_differential_test.go buildSecretsCorpus; credentials assembled at runtime in each provider's exact format so no complete secret literal is committed.

iac-misconfig.positive: a misconfigured resource for a category the owned engine covers
iac-misconfig.unknown_semantics: Closed corpus of per-category bad/good fixture pairs, scored on the category's own owned rule. A resource type outside the owned ruleset produces no finding and is never reported as compliant; the benchmark does not label such types, so a missing rule reads as 'not assessed', not 'secure'.
iac-misconfig.provenance: internal/infrastructure/tools/misconfig/checkov_differential_test.go iacCorpus; each category names the owned rule id and the checkov check id that represent it, so the head-to-head is like-for-like.

dast.positive: a vulnerable observation a passive check must flag
dast.unknown_semantics: Passive evaluation over synthetic observations, no target contacted. A check abstains (emits no finding) when an observation lacks the data it needs; abstention is never rendered as a 'secure' verdict. Corpus is a closed set of vulnerable and negative observations.
dast.provenance: internal/infrastructure/dastchecks/dast_bench_test.go; deterministic expected observations, authorization-safe by construction (no external request).

cspm.positive: a posture violation on an assessable resource
cspm.unknown_semantics: Explicit NotAssessed: an inaccessible or unknown-state resource is reported NotAssessed and never counted as compliant (TestCSPMNotAssessedIsNotCompliant). Evaluation is a pure function over a fixture Inventory and cannot mutate any cloud resource.
cspm.provenance: internal/domain/cloudposture/cspm_bench_test.go; the corpus includes an unknown-state case with a paired proof that it is not treated as compliant.

host-cve.unknown_semantics: An unsupported distro yields no correlation and is reported as unsupported, never as 'no CVEs found'. Coverage spans package identity, advisory version range, aliases, and the unsupported-distro case.
host-cve.provenance: internal/domain/advisory/hostcve_bench_test.go; labeled host/package state with expected advisory correlation, including alias and unsupported-distro cases.
